description: This file defines a serializer class ByteStringCodec for handling serialization and deserialization of ByteString objects using the Orleans serialization framework with Protocol Buffers support.

classes.name: ByteStringCodec
classes.description: A sealed serializer class for ByteString objects implementing the IFieldCodec interface.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a ByteString value from the reader, handling reference types and length-prefixed data.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Writes a ByteString value to the writer, including handling references and length-prefixed format.
